sections.name: buildDrCheck
sections.title: Build the death-overs check
sections.what: Builds the logged decisions for pace or spin at the death overs, fits the propensity, estimates both choices with the correction method, then resamples match groups to get intervals on the gap from the model.
sections.why: The file's own comments say this is exploratory and never graded.
sections.watch_out: The random sampling uses a fixed seed, so reruns match, but changing the seed changes the intervals.

summary: An offline, exploratory check that compares the model's estimate for pace versus spin bowling in the death overs with a more careful doubly robust estimate.
purpose: Shows how far the model's estimate sits from a correction-based estimate.
why: The file header and output note say this is never shown to users as fact, and the decision is never graded because too few pace balls are labelled.
how: Loads the model files and bowler styles, takes the first ball of each death over in chases, records which style was used and whether the chase was won, fits a propensity model from the required run rate, then computes the estimates and bootstrap intervals by match and writes a summary file with a hash.
inputs: The outcome and option model files, the chase samples, and the bowler styles.
outputs: data/models/dr-check-v1.json and a printed summary line.
risks: The propensity is a fitted guess, not recorded randomness. The bootstrap can run out of usable samples, which would leave intervals undefined.
debug: Check the logged decision counts. Very few pace or spin rows makes the estimate unreliable.
